text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Thank you for<n>giving me
time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I do. I was worried about falling<n>behind, so I did
some light exercise to<n>maintain my condition.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: As it's said, in times of peace,<n>prepare for strife.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's important to make good use of<n>your time off. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Grass Wonder has<n>remained vigilant
even on her day off.
